notes.title: Fixed 1.0.24
notes.content: Fixed minor bugs in the second chapter, skipping the night works when you click on your house. Fishing in the second chapter has been fixed, you can fish from a boat.

notes.title: Fixed 1.0.11
notes.content: Fixed a bug with the dark night, now it is lighter. You can replenish health by sleeping by clicking on the house when fatigue is less than half.
